Hi all 

Quick take from SE side:
- Minimal POC: ingest ~10k short prompts (under 100 tokens) + a small batch of long-form (1-2k tokens) to exercise KV cache. Run steady-state throughput and median latency benchmarks over a 48-72 hour window.
- Integration pattern: Hosted API with customer sample dataset is fastest to stand up; if FintechCo requires isolation, we can run the same POC on Dedicated but that needs a little more lead time for infra.
- Security notes: if they want VPC/on-prem, Legal will need the SOC2 artifact; Laura, can CS own the collection of any necessary customer compliance docs?
- SE availability: I can lead the POC week of Nov 29 and week of Dec 6 if needed.

I think the narrow POC + a clear success metric (50ms median for short prompts, cost target < $0.XX/token) will be persuasive.
